name: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes
title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes: Detailed EHR Comparison for Therapists
description: Compare SimplePractice and TherapyNotes - two leading EHR and practice management platforms for mental health professionals. See differences in pricing, features, telehealth, and billing.

summary.bottom_line: Both SimplePractice and TherapyNotes are excellent EHR solutions for mental health professionals. SimplePractice offers a more modern interface with broader integrations and e-prescribing, while TherapyNotes is purpose-built for behavioral health with 24/7 support and slightly lower pricing for group practices.

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice and TherapyNotes are the two most popular practice management platforms for therapists and mental health professionals. Both offer comprehensive EHR capabilities including scheduling, documentation, billing, and telehealth. SimplePractice serves a broader audience including nutritionists and wellness professionals, while TherapyNotes is specifically designed for behavioral health with clinician-built note templates.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Both platforms use per-provider pricing with tiered plans. SimplePractice starts at $49/month for basic features, while TherapyNotes starts at $69/month but includes more features at the base tier. For group practices, TherapyNotes tends to be more affordable at scale with $50/additional provider versus SimplePractice's $74/additional provider.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: The key differentiator is e-prescribing: SimplePractice offers it as an add-on ($49/mo) while TherapyNotes does not currently support e-prescribing. Both offer AI-powered documentation assistants at similar price points. TherapyNotes offers more behavioral health-specific note templates designed by clinicians, while SimplePractice has broader calendar integrations including Microsoft Outlook.

sections.heading: Customer Support
sections.content: TherapyNotes is known for exceptional customer support with 24/7 phone and email availability on all plans. SimplePractice offers support during business hours. TherapyNotes also provides free data import from other EMRs and unlimited training resources.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your specific needs:

recommendations.when: You need e-prescribing capabilities, want Microsoft Outlook calendar integration, or practice multiple wellness disciplines
You're exclusively behavioral health, want 24/7 support, prefer purpose-built mental health templates, or have a larger group practice (better value at scale)
You're a solo therapist with standard EHR needs - both are excellent choices

faqs.q: Which is cheaper for a solo therapist: SimplePractice or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: SimplePractice's Starter plan at $49/month is cheaper than TherapyNotes at $69/month. However, if you need telehealth and billing features, SimplePractice's Essential plan ($79/month) is comparable to TherapyNotes' base pricing with slightly different feature sets.
No, TherapyNotes does not currently offer e-prescribing. If you need to prescribe medications, SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as an add-on ($49/month plus $89 setup fee).

faqs.q: Which has better telehealth: SimplePractice or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Both offer HIPAA-compliant telehealth. SimplePractice includes telehealth on Essential and Plus plans. TherapyNotes includes Basic Telehealth on all plans for free, with Premium Telehealth ($15/mo) adding HD video and screen sharing.

faqs.q: Can I switch from SimplePractice to TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Yes, both platforms support data migration. TherapyNotes offers free data import from other EMRs. You should export your data from SimplePractice and contact TherapyNotes support for import assistance.
